details:
TECHWO – Selene Cadet: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

TECHWO has developed Selene Cadet, an interactive web-based lunar astronaut mission training simulator inspired by NASA's challenge, "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer." The project gives students an opportunity to experience the challenges of exploring and working on the Moon through simulated missions.

Users take the role of astronaut cadets and complete three lunar training missions: Shackleton Rim Survey, Tranquillity Relay & Rover Link, and Malapert Outpost Prep. During missions, they explore lunar terrain, navigate different surface zones, collect scientific information, and complete objectives using simulated scientific instruments such as simulated scientific instruments and activities, includingthermal probes, spectrometers, and regolith drills.

The simulator also introduces important survival challenges. Users must monitor oxygen, power, and spacesuit levels, use resources carefully, recharge at suitable locations, and respond to emergencies using available equipment. A mission dashboard displays the cadet's rank, training score, mission progress, and field guide notes.

The main goal is to make space science more engaging and accessible while developing students' problem-solving, critical-thinking, decision-making, teamwork, and resource-management skills. The project encourages curiosity about lunar exploration and inspires young learners to explore STEM fields.

Our project combines an interactive mission-based experience with scientific learning. We considered usability, beginner-friendly navigation, mission objectives, resource limitations, realistic lunar exploration challenges, and an engaging dark space-themed interface while designing the simulator.

Development tools: Google AI Studio was used for AI-assisted app development, and OpenAI ChatGPT was used for brainstorming, planning, writing, and development guidance. The project is designed as a browser-based application that can be accessed through a public web link.

AI tools assisted in the development process, while the project brings together our team's ideas to create an educational lunar exploration experience.
